text:
maria garcia: FYI @channel CloudHorizons is ready for a refkit handoff. Need terraform module review + reference-arch doc + marketplace packaging. Who can pick up module review? :wave:

alex chen: I can take module review. Share PR + any CI expectations.

maria garcia: PR here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/refkit-cloudhorizons/pull/42 — main areas: variables/outputs, multi-cloud examples (aws/gcp), and packaging metadata. Tests: terratest + tf fmt/lint in CI.

devon patel: I will own the reference architecture doc and sample topology. Thinking dedicated VPC, private endpoints, KMS integration, k8s nodepools for GPU. Will drop a quick ascii diagram in a bit.

alex chen: I have a quick Q — what TF version do we guarantee? Partner's repo currently uses 1.4 and we prefer >=1.5.

maria garcia: Our baseline is >=1.5. We can add a compatibility note and a helper upgrade script for the partner.

samira ahmad: tagging marketplace-team — packaging needs metadata keys: support_email, certified_hardware, partner_contact, and test_infra. I'll add a short checklist. :memo:

cloud-partner-bot: Onboarding checklist updated: https://redwood-internal/repo/onboarding/checklists/cloudpartner — Tasks added: module-review, refarch-doc, marketplace-metadata.

alex chen: started reviewing PR. Found missing validation for kms_key_id. Suggest adding:
```hcl
variable "kms_key_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "KMS key used for encrypting secrets"
  validation {
    condition     = length(var.kms_key_id) > 0
    error_message = "kms_key_id must be set when enable_kms = true"
  }
}
```

Also add pre-commit tfmt and `terraform init -upgrade` in CI.

devon patel: quick sketch of topology:
```text
Internet --> Load Balancer --> Private ASG (app) --> GPU nodepool
                   |--> Redis cache (private)
                   |--> Metrics/OTel collector (private endpoints)
```
I'll convert to mermaid and include security notes.

chris (CloudHorizons): Thanks — we can have our infra engineer run the sample. Timeline: marketplace listing target is next Thu (2026-04-01). Is that realistic?

maria garcia: Target seems doable. Alex — can you finish the review by EOD tomorrow? Devon — can you have doc + mermaid by Tue?

alex chen: Yep aiming EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

devon patel: Will do, will also add section on private endpoint auditing and required IAM scopes. I'll ping design for final diagrams.

maria garcia: I'll assign tasks in the partner tracker and run a quick smoke on the module today, will post results here.

alex chen: One more CI note: add a job to run `terraform validate` and `go test ./test` (terratest). Also enumerate supported regions in README and mark any known GPU SKU gaps.

maria garcia: Got it — I'll add region matrix and a small note about GPU SKUs for marketplace. Thanks everyone. :pray:
